title: Boundary enumeration fails to scale
body_md: PRIVATE_DEAD_END_NOTES: abandoned attempts and intermediate scratch work.

payload.approach: Enumerate each labelled finite path to check the endpoint count.
payload.why_it_fails: The number of labellings grows factorially and repeats equivalent paths.
payload.retry_predicate: Retry when a canonical labelling removes equivalent cases.
payload.what_was_examined: All labelled paths with up to eight vertices.
payload.scope_detection_floor: Finite exhaustive enumeration through eight vertices.
